progress.summary: The human-approved distribution reader now has measured cross-surface motion, exact reverse factoring, shared reader conformance, topology-level laws, bounded verification, production closure, and deterministic multi-viewport review evidence.

Reader chrome and browser facts can be shared while presentation adapters remain content-specific.
